text:
julia: FYI I kicked off the privileged-role prune dry-run against staging and oncall-bot just fired — 3 failed reconciles. Pausing the sweep or shall we triage live? cc @matt
oncall-bot: ALERT: access-sweep dry-run (prune-job/2026-03-21) reported 3 failed reconciles in staging cluster 'stg-a' — https://internal/alerts/394321 (details in thread)
matt: thanks. can you paste the reconcile log? was this the ownerless-role rule or svcacct-binding? we changed the owner-match rule yesterday.
julia: ownerless-role mostly. here's the snippet:
```json
{"role":"finance-admin","bindings_removed":0,"errors":["no-owner-found"]}
```
ara: we're also seeing a small spike of svcacct token errors in the same window. could be autotoken rotation overlap which would look like missing owners to the sweep. sam can you check KMS rotations around the window?
sam: on it — running: `gcloud kms keys versions list --location=global --keyring=redwood-stg-kr --key=svc-enc`
security-bot: KMS: recent key rotation detected for svc-enc at 2026-03-21T12:00:05Z — new version v3 created. transient permission mismatch is possible.
matt: that makes sense. if prune removes roles while services are mid-rotation apps will start erroring. proposal: keep dry-run paused, add a safety window (e.g., skip candidates with last-active < 72h) and add a KMS-rotation gating (no rotations in last 24h).
julia: agree. I'll update the sweep config: add delay_seconds=259200 and require no KMS rotations in last 24h. pushing change to staging config now.
julia: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/access-sweeps/pull/123 — "backoff for KMS rotations + ownerless grace window"
matt: :thumbsup: once CI passes let's rerun dry-run. also add an audit log write for every prune decision (candidate id, rationale, gate flags) so we can rollback quickly.
sam: CI green. rerunning dry-run with new gating now.
oncall-bot: INFO: dry-run finished. 0 reconciles failed. 5 candidates flagged for manual review. report: https://internal/reports/sweep/394321
ara: nice. can we add a telemetry metric `prune.manual_review_count` so product ops can track human reviews over time? cc @julia
julia: added metric and dashboard tile, scheduled weekly review with product-ops. I'll send invites and paste the post-checklist in the PR.
